title: Limeleech's Chest Key
summary: Unlocks the opulent chest in the Lodge vault.

fields.Unlock: Use it on the opulent chest on a central shelf. DC 15 Sleight of Hand can also open it. The chest contains gold, valuables and two random arrows.
fields.Acquisition: Professor Limeleech carries it. Interact with A Magical Journey in the Lodge attic to access the vault.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
